cameraEffect.shake.amplitude: Impulse strength: how much trauma a single event adds. Zero means the event does not shake at all.
cameraEffect.shake.decay: Trauma decay rate, units per second: the larger it is, the shorter the shake.
cameraEffect.shake.effect: Trauma-based camera shake: an event adds trauma, the amplitude grows as its square, and the offsets come from deterministic noise.
cameraEffect.shake.frequency: Shake noise frequency, Hz: how fast the picture trembles. Positive.
cameraEffect.shake.maxOffset: Maximum position offset at full trauma, world units.
cameraEffect.shake.maxRoll: Maximum roll at full trauma, radians.
cameraEffect.shake.radius: Distance falloff radius from the viewpoint, world units: beyond it the event does not shake. Without a value there is no falloff.
cameraEffect.sway.effect: Camera sway ("tipsiness"): a lasting effect active while the state is present on the target; an envelope eases its contribution in and out.
cameraEffect.sway.fadeSeconds: Fade-in and fade-out time of the effect, seconds: the state disappearing does not cut the picture abruptly.
